text:
{collection}.{field}: mark {mark} removed from the vocabulary.
Content written with {mark} would hold a mark the app no longer declares, and the editor binding would refuse an editor that still has it.
Keep {mark} in the vocabulary.
when: Under the lock's name, when `ncdb model build` or `ncdb model check` refuses the change against the previous lock, and in the error of opening with a lock the database refuses against the one it was last opened with: a mark is removed from a rich-text field's vocabulary.
